{{Quote|Three more gone, my lord. Two commandos took knives to one another--hallucination-induced psychosis, apparently--and Major Strix fled camp.''"<br />"''Stupid, stupid&hellip; knives? They can't even resist carving one another like roasts?!|Maiya Vix and Lord Hargrev|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''knife''', also known as a '''combat knife''' or '''throwing knife''', was a handheld [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] used for slashing and stabbing. A knife could also be used as a cutting tool or utensil.

==Description==
{{Quote|A knife never runs out of ammunition.|Myneyrshi saying|<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>}}
[[File:CombatKnife-TPoV.png|thumb|left|250px|A Kubaz wielding a combat knife]]
The knife was a simple weapon, with little to no high technology involved in its construction. It consisted of a blade attached to a pommel of short or medium length. They could be found at very cheap prices on specialized markets and were easy to conceal due to their relatively small size.

Knives were readily available and the sale of them was unregulated on most planets.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> Knives could be made of various materials, including stone, metal,<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> hardened [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]], [[Ceramic/Legends|ceramic]], and [[fiber-alloy]]. Some of the materials made the knife sharper than standard metal, and also made them difficult to detect with [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Non-metal knives were also rust-resistant and non-conductive.<ref name="SWS" />

The blade used the wielder's own strength to cut and slash, and since the weapon did not rely on any sort of [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibro]] technology, it was completely silent. The knife could also be thrown.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

Knives were not always used exclusively for combat. They were also used as a tool to accomplish a variety of purposes, such as cutting meat or [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] or [[Skinning knife|skinning hides]]. They were also used as an eating utensil or a carving tool. The expression "under the knife" referred to someone undergoing surgery, with the expression "knife" meaning the cutting tool used by the surgeon, usually a [[scalpel]].<ref name="MedStar I" />

==History==
Knives have been used throughout the ages by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], thugs, and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors,<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> as well as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of various eras. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was standard issue for [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone personnel]] (with the exception being [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]], who were issued their own [[Gauntlet vibroblade/Legends|knuckle plate vibro blades]]). [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]] soldiers<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> and later [[Galactic Alliance Infantry Trooper]]s and officers<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> were all equipped with knives, usually as a backup melee weapon.

Knives were a popular weapon in primitive cultures, such as the [[Menahuun]]<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref> and tribal [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]].<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" />

In the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], where [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] were uncommon, many people resorted to knives and long knives as their weapon of choice including, among others, the [[Waiter/Legends|waitresses]] of [[Miss Mylla]]'s [[Miss Mylla's Saloon|Saloon]].<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>
